title: The generic-extension recurrence omits membership in the next dense set.
details: Cenzer–Remmel2017, Lemma3.1.2 proof p96. After choosing the first prefix in D0, its recurrence chooses the least proper extension of the preceding prefix without requiring that it lie in D(n+1). Require both proper extension and membership in D(n+1); density provides such a prefix, and the given uniform0-prime decision computes the least one. Otherwise the produced union need not meet the designated dense sets. The corpus genericity handoff uses an explicit meet-or-avoid extension selector instead; this adjacent proof is excluded.
